user.description: The Tizen Input app must be installed on the display.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Samsung display.

pair.title: Pair for power control
pair.description: Turn the display on, then submit and select Allow on the display within 30 seconds. This lets Home Assistant turn the display on and off.

data_description.skip_pairing: Add the display without power control and pair it later from Reconfigure. Cycle then only switches inputs.

reconfigure.title: Pair for power control
reconfigure.description: Turn {name} on, then submit and select Allow on the display within 30 seconds. This lets Home Assistant turn the display on and off.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the display's local API on port 8001.
error.not_tizen: The device at this address isn't a Tizen display.
error.pairing_denied: The display denied access. Allow Home Assistant in the display's device connection settings and try again.
error.pairing_timeout: The display's prompt wasn't accepted in time. Check the display is on and try again.
error.pairing_cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the display's remote control on port 8002.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The display is paired for power control.

init.title: Cycle defaults
init.description: A Cycle press uses these only when no input has a signal.

data_description.default_entity: Buttons are pressed and other entities turned on, such as a switch that wakes a computer.
data_description.default_input: Selected after the default entity runs.
